title: Hilma af Klint painting expected to fetch SEK 8m sells for record SEK 128.9m
summary_full: A rare painting by Hilma af Klint just sold for a jaw-dropping 128.9 million Swedish kronor at auction! It blew past its original estimate of 6 to 8 million kronor. Painted in 1920 and titled Ser III No. 5, this piece had been with a family for over 30 years and shows off af Klint's unique style and spirituality.
